title: BIURO RACHUNKOWE RACHEXPERT SPÓŁKA Z OGRANICZONĄ ODPOWIEDZIALNOŚCIĄ
description:
Wrocław accounting firm. Provides full bookkeeping and simplified accounting (ryczałt, KPiR) for companies and sole traders, payroll and HR, VAT, JPK, PIT and CIT returns, and files reports with the tax office and ZUS under client powers of attorney.- annual employee income certificates and owners’ tax returns;- payroll lists and invoices under civil contracts;- employment and lease agreements, bookkeeping contracts, and data-processing agreements;- powers of attorney to file with the tax office and the social-security authority;- bank statements in zloty and euro;- sales and purchase registers, VAT returns and intra-EU reports, profit-and-loss statements and balance sheets;- invoices for rent, telecoms, transport and business trips;- older compressed accounting and payroll databases.*once the timer expires, the files will be available for sale — submit your request to the operator
